title: Record array read
summary: Evaluates the compiler's reads of an array of records: component j of element i is word i * k + j, read when i < 2^29 and 0 otherwise, and the element count is the length word divided by k.
premises: A Flat instance for the element type, with Scalar.values of length k for every element
The words of the element type's default are all 0
UInt64Array.At for flatWords xs in the store
result: The guarded read of word i * k + j equals component j of xs[i.toNat]!, as a word; for k = 1 the plain read does; the length word divided by k is xs.size.toUInt64.
